stories.headline: Brian benched Jared Goff for 37.78 and has now done it twice
stories.body:
Jared Goff scored 37.78 on Thursday night. He did it on Team Mountain's bench, while Brian started Dak Prescott, who is projected for 23.6 and has not played.

This is the second week in a row. Goff was Team Mountain's best benched player in Week 1 as well, worth 20.4 of the 62.0 points Brian left unstarted. Two weeks, one quarterback, 58.18 points watched from the sideline.

The cruel part is that it has not cost him yet. Jahmyr Gibbs went for 23.30 and Team Mountain leads I'sah Likely to win Deebo 23.30 to 7.00. Brian is winning a game in which he has already given away more points than his opponent has scored.

takes.text: TWICE! The same quarterback! In consecutive weeks! Brian Millan has looked at Jared Goff, a man who has now scored fifty-eight points for him from a seat on the bench, and said not this week either. At what point does a man take the hint that the universe is handing him?

I have watched coaches do this. You make a call on Tuesday, the week goes by, and by Sunday you are defending it instead of revisiting it. Brian is not wrong about Dak. Dak may well go for twenty-five. But you do not get the thirty-seven back, and the standings do not care which one you meant to start.

Goff outscored his projection by 18.48. Prescott is projected for 23.6 and would have to beat that by fourteen to make the decision break even. Possible. But Team Mountain's projected weekly score was 135.5 and it is now eight starters worth 109.4, which is the shape of a roster that has already spent its best week.

Fifty-eight points on the bench in two weeks. There are teams in this league that have not scored fifty-eight points in two weeks. Brian has, and he did it by accident, and he does not get to count any of it.

stories.storyline: Does Brian start Jared Goff in Week 3, or does he lose a game to the quarterback he keeps refusing to play?

stories.headline: Josh Allen scored 46.82 and the ninth-place team is leading the two seed
stories.body:
Baltimore Boofers were eighth in the power rankings, ninth in the standings, 0-1, with 112.36 points. On Thursday night Josh Allen went for 46.82 against a projection of 25.3, and Jake now leads Team Ketchup 46.82 to nothing.

Team Ketchup came in second in the rankings with a 94% playoff estimate, the best in the league. Killian has nine starters left worth 133.3 and needs 138.9 of it to come back. That is not a long shot. It is also not a position he expected to be in on a Friday.

Allen's 21.52 points over projection is the largest single overage on the board. Every public projection behind this page is built on a four-point passing touchdown. This league pays six.

takes.text: Twenty-one and a half points over on one quarterback. I have been saying the projections behind this page understate quarterbacks in a six-point league and the desk has been treating it as a hobby horse. Thursday was the first night with evidence attached, and it arrived in the biggest possible font.

Baltimore Boofers. Ninth. Zero and one. Leading the best team in the league by forty-six before anyone else has moved. I have been telling this desk that the standings are a lagging indicator and nobody listens because I say it loudly. Write it down.
Killian has a ninety-four percent playoff number and zero points. Those two facts are going to sit next to each other all weekend and one of them is going to have to apologise.

stories.storyline: Can Baltimore Boofers hold a 46.82 head start against the league's best roster, or does the two seed simply out-score it on Sunday?

stories.headline: Adam's team is named after a man sitting on his own bench, scoring nothing
stories.body:
#FreeJoshJacobs trails Scheme 0.00 to 35.20 after Amon-Ra St. Brown went for 35.20 on Thursday. Adam has nine starters left worth 107.9, the lowest remaining projection in the league, and needs 136.7 to win.

Josh Jacobs is on his bench. Josh Jacobs has no published projection at all this week, and the page has substituted 8.8 for him rather than assume zero. The team is named after him.

It does not get better from there. #FreeJoshJacobs is ninth in the power rankings, has the league's second-worst lineup efficiency at 80%, and carries a 6% playoff estimate. Only Let Baker Bake is worse, and Let Baker Bake scored 72.74 in Week 1.

takes.text: The team is called #FreeJoshJacobs. Josh Jacobs is on the bench. He does not have a projection. The projection system looked at Josh Jacobs, shrugged, and made one up out of politeness. I could not have written this.

He traded away Mike Evans' opposite number, he is starting nobody who played Thursday, he has the lowest remaining projection in the league, and he runs the newspaper! The commissioner is last in his own publication!

Eighty percent efficiency is the number I would fix first. Twenty-seven points unstarted in Week 1 is not bad luck, that is a Sunday morning problem. You can be short of talent and still stop handing games away.

stories.storyline: Does Adam's 6% playoff estimate survive another week, or is the commissioner's season effectively over in September?

stories.headline: Six matchups, five Thursday leaders, and one game nobody has started
stories.body:
Crashee'd My Ford leads Let Baker Bake 26.20 to 22.50, the tightest live margin on the board, and both got there on Thursday — James Cook and Jameson Williams for Jomi, Dalton Kincaid for Jeff. Jomi has seven starters left at 89.9 and Jeff has eight at 98.3, so the man in front has less coming.

Kamara Sutra and CeeDee's TD's are nil-nil with nine starters each, the only matchup where nothing at all has happened. #CrookedAdam leads TeenageTutenNinjaTurtles 17.20 to minus 0.10, which is the strangest scoreline of the week and entirely DJ Moore's doing.

The desk is calling all six, on the record, scored on Monday.

takes.text: Ketchup, #CrookedAdam, Scheme, Team Mountain, CeeDee's TD's and Let Baker Bake. Two of those are against a Thursday lead. Killian has 133.3 still to come and is only 46.82 behind, and Jeff has more left than Jomi does with less than four points between them.

Ketchup, #CrookedAdam, Scheme, I'sah Likely, CeeDee's TD's, Crashee'd My Ford. And I will say it plainly: Brian loses this one. A man who benches thirty-seven points twice in two weeks does not get to be 1-1.

Ketchup, #CrookedAdam, Scheme, I'sah Likely, CeeDee's TD's, Let Baker Bake. That is the projection straight down: current score plus what is left. It takes four teams that are currently behind, which tells you how little a Thursday lead is worth when eight men have not played.

Baltimore Boofers, #CrookedAdam, Scheme, Team Mountain, CeeDee's TD's, Crashee'd My Ford. I am keeping five of the six leaders because in my experience the team that is ahead on Friday spends the weekend being ahead, and the team that is behind spends it explaining.

Baltimore Boofers, TeenageTutenNinjaTurtles, #FreeJoshJacobs, Team Mountain, Kamara Sutra, Let Baker Bake. Three of those are losing right now and one of them is on nothing. A zero is not a deficit. A zero is a blank page.

stories.storyline: Who has the best record when the desk's six called shots are graded on Monday?

stories.headline: DJ Moore scored minus 0.10 and it may decide a game
stories.body:
TeenageTutenNinjaTurtles sit on minus 0.10 points. DJ Moore was projected for 13.1, played on Thursday, and finished below zero. Jack is the only manager in either league whose week has started in negative numbers.

#CrookedAdam leads that matchup 17.20 to minus 0.10 on Sam LaPorta alone. The gap is 17.30, and it exists because one team's Thursday man produced and the other's produced less than nothing.

Both have eight starters left. #CrookedAdam has 113.8 left, Jack 105.9. On the projections the lead holds, but it was built on a thirteen-point swing that nobody could have planned for.

takes.text: Negative zero point one. A man went out on national television and cost his fantasy team a tenth of a point. That is not a bad game, that is a statement of intent, and I respect it more than a quiet eleven.

Moore was projected 13.1 and returned minus 0.10. That is a 13.2-point swing on one player, in a matchup currently separated by 17.30. Single-player variance decides more of these than anyone wants to admit, which is the entire argument for caring about the other nine.
You cannot coach that. Jack did nothing wrong. He started a receiver everybody would have started and the man came back with less than he left with. Some weeks the game just takes something from you.

stories.storyline: Does #CrookedAdam's 17.30 lead survive, or does Jack's roster wash away a deficit built by one bad Thursday?

stories.headline: The desk filed championship picks in week two, which is not when you file championship picks
stories.body:
Every analyst on this desk has now named one team to win the whole thing. They were asked on Friday of week two, because that is when the commissioner thought of it. Preseason predictions are traditionally made in the preseason.

Shannon Larp took #CrookedAdam, 11-0 on all-play and averaging 162.4 a week. Stephen B Smith took Team Ketchup, second in the rankings and carrying the best playoff estimate in the league at 94%. Mina Crimes took Scheme. Skip Baseless took TeenageTutenNinjaTurtles, who nobody on this desk has ranked higher than fifth. Fat McCafferty took Baltimore Boofers, who were eighth in the power rankings and ninth in the standings when he said it.

The picks are locked. Nobody gets to change one, nobody gets a second, and there is now a tab on this site that shows all five next to how that team is actually doing, for as long as the season lasts. The commissioner, ninth in his own power rankings with a 6% playoff estimate and the second-worst lineup efficiency in the league, received no votes.

takes.text: Baltimore Boofers. Eighth in the rankings, ninth in the standings, and I do not care about either number. The standings are a lagging indicator and I am the only man in this building paid to say so at three in the morning. Write it down.

TEAM KETCHUP. Ninety-four percent. That is the best playoff number in this league and it is attached to the best roster in this league, and the only thing you cannot hand a man is the part we all find out about in December.

TeenageTutenNinjaTurtles. Everybody has them fifth. Fifth is the coward's ranking — high enough to look clever, low enough that nobody ever has to answer for it. I would rather be spectacularly wrong about a team than quietly right about nobody.

Scheme, and the reason is boring. The gap between what that roster has scored and what it has earned is the largest in the league. Those gaps close. They do not close on a schedule, which is exactly why nobody else wanted to be holding this pick.

#CrookedAdam. Eleven and nothing on all-play is not a hot week, it is a roster that has beaten everybody it could have played. I am aware that is not a brave pick. Sometimes the right answer is sitting at the top of the page and the only courage required is saying it out loud.

stories.storyline: Which of the five championship picks becomes genuinely embarrassing first?
